subject: AtlasWave pilot — confirm VP/CIO presence and backup coverage
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlaswave.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlaswave.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AtlasWave pilot — confirm VP/CIO presence and backup coverage

Hi Priya / Daniel,

Thanks again for the chance to run the pilot with AtlasWave. We want to make sure the session includes the right decision-makers so we can align on success metrics and rollout constraints. Can you confirm whether the CIO or VP-level sponsor will attend the demo on the 9th? If the CIO is tied up, a VP of Eng or VP of Product typically works well.

Proposed demo window (Pacific):
- Option A: Thu, Nov 9 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Thu, Nov 9 — 13:00–13:45 PT
- Option C: Fri, Nov 10 — 09:00–09:45 PT

Quick asks:
- Who will be the executive sponsor attending (CIO / VP Eng / VP Product)?
- Any constraints on the agenda we should prioritize (security, latency, integration checklist)?

Attaching a short deck and a 15-minute pre-brief agenda we can run the day before if it helps get the execs prepped.

Thanks — happy to adapt the slot.

– Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: AtlasWave_ShortDeck_v1.pdf (PDF, 3.2 MB), AtlasWave_Prebrief_Agenda.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlaswave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlaswave.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasWave pilot — confirm VP/CIO presence and backup coverage

Thanks, Rishi — appreciate the thoroughness. Quick update from our side: our CIO, Vanessa Kumar, is traveling that week and won’t be available during the 9th–10th window. Our CTO (Derek Li) can attend, and I can also ask our VP of Product to join if that helps cover commercial questions.

Prefered slot from our side is Option B (Nov 9, 13:00 PT) but there's a conflict from 13:00–13:30 for Derek. Would 13:30–14:15 PT on Nov 9 work? Alternatively, we can do 10:00–10:45 PT on Nov 9 if Derek shifts.

Two small requests: could you share a 30-second list of the key metrics you’ll demo (latency per request, throughput at 8k tokens, cost estimates) and can you confirm if you need network access to our staging environment?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah
Director, Strategic Initiatives | AtlasWave
priya.shah@atlaswave.com | +1 (212) 555-0147

On Thu, Nov 2, 2028 at 09:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Priya / Daniel,
>
> Thanks again for the chance to run the pilot with AtlasWave. We want to make sure the session includes the right decision-makers so we can align on success metrics and rollout constraints...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlaswave.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlaswave.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasWave pilot — confirm VP/CIO presence and backup coverage

Priya — great, thanks for the fast reply. 13:30–14:15 PT on Nov 9 works for us; I’ll hold that as the tentative slot until we have final confirmation from Derek.

To address your asks:
- Key metrics we plan to show (concise): latency P50/P95 for short (256 tokens) and long (2k tokens) flows; sustained throughput under continuous batching; per-token cost projection using our quantized profile.
- We do not need inbound network access for the demo — we’ll run a recorded integration against your staging API and then show live inference from a small sample in your staging if you want. If you prefer an in-network demo, let us know and we’ll bring the network ops engineer.

If the CIO is unavailable, our recommendation is to have Derek (CTO) + one business sponsor (VP Product or VP Ops). If Derek can’t make the end of the slot, we can provide:
- Derek attends for the first 20 minutes (architecture and performance)
- Hannah (CSM) will pick up the final 25 minutes for rollout/contract questions and next steps
- Optionally run a 15-min pre-brief the day before to get Derek up to speed — I’ve attached the prebrief agenda.

Can you confirm Derek's availability for 13:30–14:15 PT? If yes, we’ll lock the calendar and send an invite (including a short agenda and the short deck).

– Rishi

> On Thu, Nov 2, 2028 at 11:40, Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlaswave.com> wrote:
> > Thanks, Rishi — appreciate the thoroughness...

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlaswave.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@atlaswave.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasWave pilot — confirm VP/CIO presence and backup coverage

Hi Priya / Daniel — following up to confirm final logistics. Derek (CTO) confirmed he can join 13:30–14:15 PT on Thu, Nov 9. We’ve locked the slot and sent a calendar invite titled “AtlasWave — Redwood pilot demo” to the attendees.

Attachments included in the invite:
- AtlasWave_ShortDeck_v1.pdf (source deck)
- AtlasWave_Prebrief_Agenda.docx (prebrief details — 15min, Wed Nov 8 @ 10:00 PT recommended)
- AtlasWave_Demo_20281109.ics (calendar invite)

Quick notes for the day:
- Rishi will open with objectives (5m) and success criteria.
- Derek will cover architecture and integration (20m).
- Hannah will run rollout + commercial next steps (20m).
- Last 10m for Q&A and immediate next steps.

If you prefer a 10-minute prebrief instead of 15, we can compress — just confirm attendee list. Priya, can you confirm whether VP Product will also join, or should we plan for just Derek + Daniel?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: AtlasWave_Demo_20281109.ics (ICS, 2 KB), AtlasWave_ShortDeck_v1.pdf (PDF, 3.2 MB), AtlasWave_Prebrief_Agenda.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)
